title: [DRAFT] Support for custom uniform buffers and shader storage buffers in GDShaders

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Right now, the only ways to pass data to a GDShader is through uniforms or textures. Uniforms are solidly limited by the capacity of the single UBO dedicated to material uniforms and they don't support structs, while textures can be confusing to work with and require wasting performance encoding and decoding them. This PR adds syntax to GDShaders for both uniform and storage buffers, as well as methods to set them from a script. 

An example of the syntax I have implemented is:
`buffer uniform restrict my_buf {`
`    float bufFloat; `
`}(bindname = myBuffer, format = std140)`
The buffer value could then be read in the shader as `my_buf.bufFloat`. 

To set the values in the buffer from a script, you would use 
`myshadermat.set_shader_buffer("myBuffer", 
    { "bufFloat": 0.1 })`
You can also directly set the buffer values with a PackedByteArray if you prefer via `set_shader_buffer_raw()`
 
Right now, the buffers work properly and can be assigned to and read from without issue. Structs can be passed through buffers, as well as arrays (and arrays of structs). Once everything is feature complete, I'll clean up the commits and reformat this PR to be better structured, but I figured it was worth sharing as is.

Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7516
Also closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/6989

If you want to quickly see a project implementing it, I have published my water rendering project that I've been using for testing so far, which can be accessed [here](https://github.com/Fluxx7/SSBO-testing). I'm going to continue to update this project to try and make it a proper demo for the various options, it is very WIP right now so the code is sort of a nightmare.

Completed work (somewhat summarized):
- [X] Implement syntax for declaring both UBOs and SSBOs
- [X] Add support to compiler for buffer instantiation + buffer value accesses
- [X] Properly allocate and bind buffers to material uniform set
- [X] Implement API for scripts to set buffer data
- [X] Implement completion options for buffers, buffer fields, and buffer formats
- [X] Support using both named and unnamed buffers
- [X] Support both std140 and std430 for storage buffers
- [X] Abstract the process of setting buffer values from scripts

Remaining work in rough order of priority:

- [ ] Ensure support for buffers being shared between shaders
- [ ] Fix unsized storage buffer arrays (I know what's going wrong but it's gonna be a pain to fix)
- [ ] Add support for buffers as a global parameter
- [ ] Fix completion options for buffer IO qualifiers
- [ ] Add parser checks to ensure that writeonly buffers cannot be read from (not sure writeonly buffers are even necessary tbh)
- [ ] Validate that storage buffer values can be changed by the shader (again, not sure this is really useful but no reason not to have it)
- [ ] Write unit tests
- [ ] Write documentation
- [ ] Final optimizations
